## Installation gate

Record the assigned asset, exact target drive model/capacity, preserved files, approved installer, and firmware detection. The teacher must confirm any erase or partition choice.

Use the live session first to test display, keyboard, mouse, USB, sound, and network. After approval, install the classroom image, apply approved updates, and verify CPU, RAM, storage, USB, sound, display, network, restart, and login.

::: {.callout-important title="Data safety"}
An erase-disk installation destroys data on the selected drive. Confirm the exact target and preserve required files before continuing.
:::

Official references: [Linux Mint download](https://linuxmint.com/download.php/) and [installation guide](https://linuxmint-installation-guide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/install.html).
